summary: Totem and direct-heal hybrid healer. Riptide (new level-60 capstone) is a direct heal plus HoT that also buffs your next Chain Heal on that target, tying single-target and raid healing together.

mechanicalChanges.detail: Most lasting totems (incl. healing ones) now last 5 min instead of Classic's 2 min; Mana Spring and Healing Stream specifically were 1 min in Classic. Short-duration totems (Searing, Magma, Stoneclaw, Earthbind, Grounding, Mana Tide) keep their original short timers.

mechanicalChanges.change: Call of the Elements / Ancestors / Spirits
mechanicalChanges.detail: New multi-totem drop spells: each drops up to four totems from its own totem bar set in a single 3 sec cast (Elements at 20, Ancestors at 30, Spirits at 40).

statPriority.rationale: Healing Power improves the result, Intellect funds the mana pool, and Mindfulness gives Spirit value during casts. Keep enough Stamina to survive a stray hit that interrupts/pushes back a heal.

priority: Use Water Shield while healing, and place a useful Mana Spring Totem from level 26 on.
Start Healing Wave when there's time for the larger cast; use Lesser Healing Wave when waiting for that cast would leave the target at risk.
Use Healing Stream for recurring group damage, and pick Tremor or a cleansing totem when the enemy's effects make it useful.
At 25, use Mana Tide where group members can stay in range. At 30, reserve Nature's Swiftness for an urgent Nature heal or a heal-while-moving.

gearingNotes.note: Critical heals can consume Water Shield globes — check the shield during long pulls and account for refreshing it.
Enchant Bracer - Minor Healing Power: +8 healing on bracers, permanently.

keyTalents: Riptide (7/2 capstone) — direct heal + HoT, sets up a stronger Chain Heal
Nature's Swiftness — instant cast on next Nature spell under 10 sec cast time
Water Shield — passive mana return, replaces Classic's reliance on Mana Spring alone
Mana Tide Totem — burst mana restoration for the group
Ancestral Healing — armor buff on your target after a healing crit

recommendedBuild.leveling21pt: 5/5 Improved Healing Wave, 3/3 Mindfulness, 2/5 Tidal Focus, 1/1 Water Shield, 3/3 Healing Focus, 3/5 Tidal Focus (complete), 1/1 Mana Tide Totem, 4/5 Tidal Mastery, 1/1 Nature's Swiftness
recommendedBuild.note: Point order is the community's best guess (explicitly "haven't been tested in game"), not confirmed optimal.

caveat: Forever beta, level cap 30 as of 2026-10. Most rotation/stat-priority claims are explicitly labeled 'classic-assumed' by their own source (classicwowforever.com) — meaning nothing in the beta client contradicts Classic Era behavior, not that it's been confirmed. Treat as a strong starting point, not settled fact.
